🎮 Getting Started – Web3 Fighter
What is Web3 Fighter?
Web3 Fighter is a 3D fighting game inspired by classics like Tekken and Street Fighter, built using Three.js. Players control unique fighters in fast-paced battles, using combos, timing, and strategy to defeat opponents. 🚀 Quick Start (Play the Game)
Open the Game
Visit: [your game link]
Load Your Fighter
Choose or spawn your character
Learn the Controls
Move: WASD or Arrow Keys
Attack: J / K / L (edit this to match your controls)
Block: Shift
Start Fighting
Enter a match or practice mode
🧰 Requirements
Modern browser (Chrome recommended)
Keyboard (controller support if you add it later)
Stable internet connection
